findings.rationale: Duplicate detection keys an irreversible completion from the top-level correlation_id when present, while the modeled transition retains params.correlation_id via or_insert. A log can vary the top-level value while keeping the transition's correlation parameter fixed, bypassing duplicate_irreversible_effect_commit detection for the same modeled correlation.

run_diff_git preserves a child error in the numeric status but derives gate.passed only from child gate violations. Error envelopes have no gate, so a batch containing a parse, semantic, or internal error can publish passed=true; outcome_class consequently reports Success while the CLI exits nonzero.

The AI check forwards only verifier status 2, although the shared contract defines only statuses 0 and 1 as definitive. A status-3 internal verifier error is passed into check_ai and reclassified by wrap_specialized, potentially replacing the internal error with an AI verdict and a different exit status.

Literate verification truncates a predictable sibling path derived from the process ID using fs::write. A pre-created symlink at that path is followed, allowing an attacker with access to the source directory to redirect the write to another file; the guard later removes only the predictable path.
